AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
A real sequence {γ_k}_{k≥0} is a multiplier sequence if it preserves
hyperbolicity of real polynomials under
coefficientwise multiplication. Characterize which multiplier
sequences are also complex zero decreasing sequences,
meaning they do not increase the number of nonreal zeros of any real
polynomial.

evidence.quote: Problem 19 ([62, 11, 21]). A sequence T = {γk }∞ k=0 of realP n multiplier sequence if, whenever P the real polynomial p(x) = k=0 ak xk is hypern k bolic, the polynomial T [p(x)] := k=0 γk ak x is also hyperbolic.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A real polynomial is called hyperbolic if all of its zeros are real. A sequence T = {γ_k}_{k=0}^∞ of real numbers is called a multiplier sequence if, for every hyperbolic real polynomial p(x) = Σ_{k=0}^n a_k x^k, the polynomial T[p](x) := Σ_{k=0}^n γ_k a_k x^k is also hyperbolic. The sequence T is called a complex zero decreasing sequence (CZDS) if for every real polynomial p(x) = Σ_{k=0}^n a_k x^k one has Z_C(T[p]) ≤ Z_C(p), where Z_C(q) denotes the number of nonreal zeros of q counted with multiplicity (with the convention that if T[p] is identically zero then Z_C(T[p]) = 0).

Give an intrinsic characterization of all multiplier sequences {γ_k}_{k=0}^∞ that are simultaneously complex zero decreasing sequences.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing all multiplier sequences that are complex zero decreasing sequences is known as the Karlin–Laguerre problem and is widely regarded as a long-standing open problem in the theory of zero-preserving linear operators. Partial results exist (e.g., complete characterization of CZDS interpolated by polynomials, and constructions for various classical polynomial bases), but no general intrinsic characterization is known.

status_evidence.title: Composition theorems, Multiplier sequences and Complex Zero Decreasing Sequences (Craven-Csordas survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizing all CZDS is an open problem, as is the special case of characterizing all meromorphically interpolated CZDS.
status_evidence.claim: General characterization of CZDS, including those that are multiplier sequences, remains open.

status_evidence.title: Complex Zero Decreasing Sequences — Craven and Csordas
status_evidence.snippet: The Karlin-Laguerre problem asks to characterize all multiplier sequences which are complex zero decreasing sequences.
status_evidence.claim: This is the Karlin–Laguerre problem, a long-standing open problem.
